Jhaam, named in-game as Executed Drow, is a dead drow[1] and Harper in Baldur's Gate 3.

Involvement

Act One

Jhaam's corpse is in Grymforge in one of the cages near Murmath at X: -632 Y: 388. She was sent by  Jaheira to investigate rumours of ⁠Absolutist activity in Grymforge as well as find out what they "might seek amidst the ruins".[2] Jhaam had orders to bring word of the cult's deeds back to Last Light Inn, but she was caught and killed by  Murmath.

  • Creased Letter

Speak with Dead

Jhaan's corpse can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Executed Drow
      Jhaam... Harper scout...
  • What were you doing here?
    • Executed Drow
      Cultists... threat to Baldur's Gate... Jaheira's orders...
  • What happened to you?
    • Executed Drow
      Caught... interrogated... hanged...
  • Who killed you?
    • Executed Drow
      Duergar cultist... True Soul's command...
  • Where are you from?
    • Executed Drow
      Last Light... safe haven... in shadows...
  • What is your profession?
    • Executed Drow
      Scout... Harper...
  • Where are your valuables?
    • Executed Drow
      Have... none...
